summary: Shared libraries and packages used across the monorepo.
context_hints: Check here for shared code between Frontend and Backend
Contains the 'shared-types' package, which is the source of truth for protocols
Contains Remotion packages for video generation components

make lint includes workspace source TypeScript checks plus existing ESLint tasks. Source-check configs use root tsconfig.source.json; browser/runtime aliases are generated from sparse source-check-profiles.json. No release build or repository dist is required.

subdirectories.shared-replica: Portable durable replica engine and Loro protocol adapters; infrastructure is supplied through ports.
subdirectories.shared-artifact-evals: Outcome-driven headless creative benchmark runner and artifact graders.
subdirectories.mcp-server: Internal typed peer capability surface and Canvas App used by the bundled Clash plugin; calls local-api directly and is not a standalone daemon.
subdirectories.shared-mcp: Shared Clash MCP server and fail-closed wire-schema compatibility boundary.
subdirectories.shared-types: TypeScript Zod definitions that generate Python Pydantic models. The Protocol Layer.
subdirectories.remotion-core: Core video processing logic and hooks for Remotion.
subdirectories.remotion-ui: UI components specifically for the video editor interface.
subdirectories.shared-cloud-schema: Backend-only SQLite/D1 Drizzle table definitions and Better Auth ORM relations, with narrow auth/app/broker/runtime exports and preserved API/Web migration profiles.

architecture_notes: Packages are managed via pnpm workspaces. Changes here often require rebuilding dependent apps.
